channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont officials are urging residents to make a plan to vote in the November third election. Governor Phil Scott and Secretary of State Sarah Copeland Hanzas assure voters the process is safe and secure despite national challenges. They remind everyone to respect local election workers and be prepared for any disruptions.

Pittsford could raise about one hundred sixty-four thousand dollars a year with a local option tax on rooms, meals, and alcohol. Town officials are considering asking voters to approve the tax to help pay for infrastructure projects. This could ease property tax burdens for residents if passed.

In Orwell, two local citizens have purchased the former Buxton’s Store to support its revival as a community hub. They will sell the building to a nonprofit dedicated to restoring the store. This effort aims to bring back an important gathering place for the town.

Vermont’s top ski resorts Stowe, Okemo, and Mount Snow aim to open for the season on November twenty-first. They’re part of Vail Resorts, offering the Epic Pass for access to many mountains. New digital tools in the My Epic app will enhance lessons and track progress for skiers and riders.
